policy: Official host behavior is authoritative; MLX adaptations stay at tensor, loader, device, cache and resource boundaries.

Model rows bounded by constructor batch_size; logical state batch follows official controls
Native compilation and dtype controls retained; PyTorch/CUDA/ONNX execution refused
Bounded question-prefix cache keyed by tokenizer, rendered options, order and head budget
Core ML host extraction used as an intermediate, verified against official v0.4.12 assertions and differential tests
Config property exposes cfg to upstream OptionStabilityHook for native parallel layouts
Native encoder embeddings retained; fake Torch encoder/tokenizer replaced by MLX fixtures in MCP cache assertions
Optional PyTorch import only for temperature fitting/reward helpers, not inference or calibration loading
Native warmup(shapes=None) mirrors upstream synthetic shapes, token cap, no-hook execution and elapsed-seconds return
compile_warmup is honored for native MLX compile; automatic warmup warns on failure while explicit warmup propagates errors

Final native wheel source verified against qualification source hash
behavior_changes: Router max_loaded defaults to official 2 instead of 1
Registry changes wait for in-flight construction; old callers may finish with the old agent
Official input validation accepts scalar choice labels and returns official error types/messages
Empty question usage contains only input_tokens and output_tokens
Score legend values use rendered text
